ccel.title: ANF03. Latin Christianity: Its Founder, Tertullian

source.title: ANF03. Latin Christianity: Its Founder, Tertullian
ANF03. Latin Christianity: Its Founder, Tertullian

verses.text: For what has God, who exacts it ever denied to prayer coming from “spirit and truth?”
verses.modernizedText: For what has God, who exacts it ever denied to prayer coming from “spirit and truth?”

verses.text: How mighty specimens of its efficacy do we read, and hear, and believe!
verses.modernizedText: How mighty specimens of its efficacy do we read, and hear, and believe!

verses.text: Old-world prayer, indeed, used to free from fires, and from beasts, and from famine; and yet it had not (then) received its form from Christ.
verses.modernizedText: Prayer in former times, indeed, used to free from fires, and from beasts, and from famine; and yet it had not (then) received its form from Christ.

verses.text: But how far more amply operative is Christian prayer!
verses.modernizedText: But how much more powerfully Christian prayer works!

verses.text: It does not station the angel of dew in mid-fires, nor muzzle lions, nor transfer to the hungry the rustics’ bread; it has no delegated grace to avert any sense of suffering; but it supplies the suffering, and the feeling, and the grieving, with endurance: it amplifies grace by virtue, that faith may know what she obtains from the Lord, understanding what—for God’s name’s sake—she suffers.
verses.modernizedText: It does not station the angel of dew in mid-fires, nor muzzle lions, nor transfer to the hungry the rustics’ bread; it has no delegated grace to avert any sense of suffering; but it supplies the suffering, and the feeling, and the grieving, with endurance: it amplifies grace by virtue, that faith may know what she obtains from the Lord, understanding what—for God’s name’s sake—she suffers.

verses.text: But in days gone by, withal prayer used to call down plagues, scatter the armies of foes, withhold the wholesome influences of the showers.
verses.modernizedText: But in days gone by, prayer also used to call down plagues, scatter the armies of foes, withhold the wholesome influences of the showers.

verses.text: Now, however, the prayer of righteousness averts all God’s anger, keeps bivouac on behalf of personal enemies, makes supplication on behalf of persecutors.
verses.modernizedText: Now, however, the prayer of righteousness averts all God’s anger, keeps bivouac on behalf of personal enemies, makes supplication on behalf of persecutors.

verses.text: Is it wonder if it knows how to extort the rains of heaven—(prayer) which was once able to procure its fires?
verses.modernizedText: Is it wonder if it knows how to extort the rains of heaven—(prayer) which was once able to procure its fires?

verses.text: Prayer is alone that which vanquishes God.
verses.modernizedText: Prayer is alone that which vanquishes God.

verses.text: But Christ has willed that it be operative for no evil: He had conferred on it all its virtue in the cause of good.
verses.modernizedText: But Christ has willed that it be operative for no evil: He has given it all its power in the cause of good.

verses.text: And so it knows nothing save how to recall the souls of the departed from the very path of death, to transform the weak, to restore the sick, to purge the possessed, to open prison-bars, to loose the bonds of the innocent.
verses.modernizedText: And so it knows only how to recall the souls of the departed from the very path of death, to transform the weak, to restore the sick, to purge the possessed, to open prison-bars, to loose the bonds of the innocent.

verses.text: Likewise it washes away faults, repels temptations, extinguishes persecutions, consoles the faint-spirited, cheers the high-spirited, escorts travellers, appeases waves, makes robbers stand aghast, nourishes the poor, governs the rich, upraises the fallen, arrests the falling, confirms the standing.
verses.modernizedText: Likewise it washes away faults, repels temptations, extinguishes persecutions, consoles the fainthearted, cheers the high-spirited, escorts travellers, appeases waves, makes robbers stand aghast, nourishes the poor, governs the rich, upraises the fallen, arrests the falling, confirms the standing.

verses.text: Prayer is the wall of faith: her arms and missiles against the foe who keeps watch over us on all sides.
verses.modernizedText: Prayer is the wall of faith: her arms and missiles against the foe who keeps watch over us on all sides.

verses.text: And, so never walk we unarmed.
verses.modernizedText: And so let us never walk unarmed.

verses.text: By day, be we mindful of Station; by night, of vigil.
verses.modernizedText: By day, let us be mindful of Station; by night, of vigil.

verses.text: Under the arms of prayer guard we the standard of our General; await we in prayer the angel’s trump.
verses.modernizedText: Under the arms of prayer let us guard the standard of our General; let us await in prayer the angel’s trump.

verses.text: The angels, likewise, all pray; every creature prays; cattle and wild beasts pray and bend their knees; and when they issue from their layers and lairs, they look up heavenward with no idle mouth, making their breath vibrate after their own manner.
verses.modernizedText: The angels, likewise, all pray; every creature prays; cattle and wild beasts pray and bend their knees; and when they issue from their layers and lairs, they look up heavenward with no idle mouth, making their breath vibrate after their own manner.

verses.text: Nay, the birds too, rising out of the nest, upraise themselves heavenward, and, instead of hands, expand the cross of their wings, and say somewhat to seem like prayer.
verses.modernizedText: Nay, the birds too, rising out of the nest, upraise themselves heavenward, and, instead of hands, expand the cross of their wings, and say something that seems like prayer.

verses.text: What more then, touching the office of prayer?
verses.modernizedText: What more then, concerning the office of prayer?

verses.text: Even the Lord Himself prayed; to whom be honour and virtue unto the ages of the ages!
verses.modernizedText: Even the Lord Himself prayed; to whom be honour and virtue to the ages of the ages!
